name: Big Mouth
summary: Big Mouth tells the story of an underperforming lawyer who gets caught up in a murder case. In order to survive and protect his family, he digs into a huge conspiracy among the privileged upper classes.

episodes.name: "Because I'll show you what real despair is like"
